Maria: Draft is up in Google Drive — product launch blog v3. Link in thread. Need a quick editorial + legal pass by EOD. Can people skim? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Aj: reading now, will check CTAs and inbound routing. want to push a 2-step CTA (webinar -> demo) or single demo CTA?@Leo any routing constraints?
Tom: re: hero, I mocked two crops here: https://drive.re/hero_vA.png & https://drive.re/hero_vB.png. lean toward vB for momentum. cc @Maria :eyes:
Sasha: quick flag — two claims in section 2 look like product guarantees. please remove/soften until we have legal wording. I can suggest language, but need time.
Leo: demo ops: we have capacity for two demo slots/day the week after launch. recommend webinar -> calendar flow using /webhook to SFDC. Aj, we need the lead tag: "post-launch-webinar" for routing.
Aj: good — I'll wire the webhook and tag. Also recommend we stagger the publish time to 09:00 PT for APAC overlap.
Maria: updated doc to v3.1 with Sasha's inline suggestions removed, Tom's hero vB added, Aj to wire webhook. Action items:
```
- Sasha: legal suggested phrasing by 5pm PT
- Aj: webhook + lead tag + stagger publish time
- Tom: export hero_vB @ 2x and deliver to web
- Leo: confirm demo slots + calendar link
- Maria: final copy + publish queue
```
Tom: I'll drop the export in the drive by 3pm.
Sasha: dropping quick phrasing now, putting comments in the doc. Use this instead for the guarantee line: "we aim to deliver" -> safer language.
Aj: webhook configured and test event sent to sandbox. sample payload: `{
  "lead_source": "post_launch_blog",
  "tags": ["post-launch-webinar"],
  "email": "test+webhook@redwood.ai"
}`
Leo: calendar link created: https://cal.re/demo-postlaunch. Confirmed 2 slots/day next week. I'll hand off to AE queue.
Maria: perfect — I'm going to submit final to publishing queue after Sasha's last comment clears. Planning publish: 2024-05-10 09:00 PT. If anything blocks, ping me. :thumbsup:
PublishBot: Publishing job queued: job_id=pub-20240510-001, ETA 09:00 PT on 2024-05-10.
Maria: thanks all — final followups in doc. :rocket:
